limitations: A conservative finite-answer fixture gate, not a general semantic or production-readiness benchmark. Valid unlisted paraphrases fail and need human review; do not quietly loosen this version.

The 12 legacy prompts are a semantic recheck, not newly held-out evidence. The 24 new challenges were authored after the pinned candidate was trained; no claim of exhaustive corpus decontamination is made.

Fresh decoding stops only at the actual emitted EOS token. The full legacy raw outputs are separately rescored without trimming; noise after EOS in the old fixed-length generator is not assumed to be a served answer.
INT4 weights are reconstructed on CPU. This checks quantized-weight behavior, not performance of a native INT4 serving kernel.
No tools are executed and no deployment is authorized. A PASS only clears this bounded gate.
